status: mass+x-y-time pair-support preflight frozen before donor vertical scores
role: post-freeze exploratory morphology mechanism test; distinct continuous-gradient family; cannot alter v0.3.8 submission claims
ecological_hypothesis: If body size contributes to vertical organization, vertical profiles from other individuals with body mass closer to the target should transfer better to that target than profiles from mass-dissimilar donors.

feasibility.donor_pair_support: For each target session and each other-individual donor in the same frozen cohort, a target endpoint is pair-supported if its 5-km cell × kinematic-state stratum occurs in at least one retained donor session.
feasibility.pair_aggregation: A donor-target pair is structurally evaluable if at least one target session has >=50 donor-supported endpoints.
feasibility.target_individual_evaluable: at least 4 structurally evaluable donor individuals with nonmissing animal mass and at least 3 distinct absolute mass differences
feasibility.panel_gate: at least 70% of the kinematic-state baseline evaluable n and at least 5 target individuals in every panel
feasibility.decision: If all five panels pass, freeze exact target n and open the vertical donor-gradient outcome. Otherwise stop this five-panel continuous mass-gradient family.

planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.donor_profile: equal-session P(centered residual height | 5-km cell, kinematic state) from the donor individual's retained sessions
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.target_session_score: mean log donor profile probability on donor-supported target endpoints minus the equal-individual other-donor population profile probability on the same target endpoints
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.target_donor_score: equal-session mean donor-specific predictive gain for that target individual
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.target_statistic: Spearman rho between absolute donor-target mass difference and target-donor predictive gain; expected negative
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.null: permute animal-mass labels among eligible individuals within frozen cohort while holding all donor-target predictive scores and support fixed; recompute target rhos and panel mean
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.panel_support_rule: observed panel mean rho < 0 and one-sided p(null <= observed) <= 0.05
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.synthesis: 4 or 5 panels support => body-mass similarity is a general predictor of cross-individual vertical organization; 2 or 3 => context-dependent; 0 or 1 => simple body mass is not a general mechanism.

claim_boundary: Animal mass is an incomplete morphology proxy and is not wing loading.
A negative gradient would be associative, not causal.
Failure would not rule out wing shape, experience, memory or other stable traits.
This family is distinct from the stopped close/far donor-pool design and is frozen before any vertical donor score is opened.
This extension remains outside the frozen v0.3.8 submission package.
stop_rule: Do not change the >=50 pair support, >=4 donors, >=3 distinct mass distances, 70% panel retention, >=5 target floor, kinematic-state definition, panel set, permutation count/seeds or support rule after preflight/output.
Do not group mass or substitute tag mass/sex if the continuous gradient fails.
Do not drop a panel after seeing preflight or vertical outcomes.
